non_drill.reason: direct-object marker, usually untranslated -- not recallable from a gloss

entries.core_schema: Direction toward something -- reaching it (to) or benefiting it (for) is the same motion.
A bounded space you're inside -- in, on, or acting within it (with).

entries.gloss: (marks a definite direct object -- usually untranslated)

entries.core_schema: Motion away from a source -- literal (from a place) or figurative (some of, than). Same word as the standalone min.
Contact with weight from above -- on, over, or (metaphorically) against/about.
Not one idea but three jobs, told apart by context: a reason (because/for), a quotation or fact (that), or a time clause (when).
Comparison or approximation -- like, as, or (with a number) about/roughly.
A limit reached -- in time (until) or space (as far as) is the same idea.
Motion away from a source -- from, out of, some of, or than (comparison = distance from a standard). Same word as the prefix mi-.

entries.core_schema: Behind in space is after in time -- same word, same image.

entries.gloss: under, instead of, in place of
entries.core_schema: Under something -- literally (underneath) or by substitution (in its place, instead of).
